response.justification: The candidate lacks critical qualifications for the role: no demonstrated experience with C programming in UNIX/embedded environments, no Linux kernel modification experience, no exposure to embedded networking security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X, and no Japanese language proficiency — all of which are mandatory requirements.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven ability to build and maintain complex systems including embedded-like GIS and real-time applications
Active contributor to open-source tools and developer education, showing technical depth and communication skills
concerns: No C programming experience in embedded or UNIX contexts as required
No evidence of Linux kernel analysis, modification, or security vulnerability countermeasures
No Japanese language proficiency — a non-negotiable requirement for the role

key_factors.factor: Lack of networking security domain knowledge
